item.title: Oak tree outside No 16 Pittville Crescent, 7th November
item.description:
According to someone in the Crescent, this oak tree was inspected by the Council in June/July with a view of it being felled as it has lost many small branches and the larger branches may be a hazard. Oak trees can take a 100 years to die and are beneficial to nature and birds in their decline. Please could you let me know if this tree a) is healthy, b) is going to be felled or whether just the branches that may break off in a storm be lopped? c) when felling or lopping is likely to happen?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 9, Pittville Crescent, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
